Annotation Interface Icon

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(METHOD) @Repeatable(Icons.class) public @interface Icon
An icon of an MCP tool, prompt, resource or resource template, declared on the annotated method. It is ignored unless the method is also annotated with Tool, Prompt, Resource or ResourceTemplate. 
@Tool
@Icon(src = "https://example.com/weather.svg", mimeType = "image/svg+xml")
String weather(String city) { ... }
Since:
2.2.0

  • Element Details

    • src

      String src
      Returns:
      The URI of the icon: an HTTPS URL or a data:image/... URI. An HTTP URL is accepted, for example for local development. A blank value, another scheme, or a URL with a user name or password fails the startup.

    • mimeType

      String mimeType
      Returns:
      The MIME type of the icon, if it cannot be inferred from the URI.
      Default:
      ""

    • sizes

      String[] sizes
      Returns:
      The sizes the icon is available in, such as 48x48, or any for a scalable format.
      Default:
      {}

    • theme

      String theme
      Returns:
      The theme the icon is designed for, light or dark, in lowercase. Empty for any theme. Any other value fails the startup.
      Default:
      ""
